messages:
maya: Quick design pass on the Prompt Collections -> Evals list. Pulled a few things while testing the regression diffs and approval flow. TL;DR: layout tweaks, copy tweaks for CTAs, and keyboard focus nits.

jonathan: thanks — drop the screenshots or the prototype link?

maya: prototype: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/prompt-collections-evals (page: Regression list compact view)

maya: 1) Compact row density feels ok, but the diff preview needs a stronger visual separator. Right now two lines blur together. Maybe add a subtle 1px divider + increased left padding on the diff block.

tara: agree on the divider. Also the timestamp + tag row is cramped when a scorecard legend shows. can we move the legend into a hover tooltip to reduce density?

kevin: hover tooltip works for mouse, but we need keyboard accessible way to reveal the legend. Maybe a small info button with aria-expanded that toggles an inline mini-panel?

maya: good call. Proposal: show a compact info icon (tabbable) that opens a small panel anchored to the row with the legend. Panel should be dismissible with Esc and trap focus while open.

jonathan: works. Accessibility checklist item: ensure panel id referenced with aria-controls and the info button has aria-haspopup="dialog".

maya: 2) Approval CTA copy: current button says "Approve selected". For bulk approvals, PM asked for "Approve & record" because we always tie the approval to a release note. Thoughts?

tara: i worry that "& record" is ambiguous. Users might ask "record what?" Maybe: "Approve and add note" or show a small confirmation flow that prompts for a note.

kevin: prefer keeping primary action short: "Approve" and then on confirmation modal have a required (or optional) note field. That keeps the CTA predictable and consistent with other flows.

maya: ok let's keep primary CTA as "Approve". Change the confirmation modal title to "Approve test suite — add release note" and make the note optional by default but required if user toggles "Require release note" in team settings.

design-bot: mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/approve-modal-v2 (frame: approve-modal-note) :white_check_mark:

jonathan: 3) Regression diff inline actions — the three-dot menu currently shows "Re-run", "Mark as expected", "Ignore". For speed we should expose keyboard shortcuts printed in the menu: e.g., Re-run (r), Mark expected (m), Ignore (i). Also add a tiny tooltip showing shortcut on hover.

tara: can we avoid single-letter shortcuts that conflict with browser/OS or other global shortcuts? maybe use modifiers: r => Shift+R?

kevin: we already use single-letter shortcuts in the scorecard view without modifiers. for consistency, use single letters but only active when the row has focus. document in keyboard shortcuts help.

maya: 4) Visual regression thumbnails are low-contrast on dark backgrounds. Two options: light border + slight box-shadow or switch to a neutral background tile. I prefer border + 2px rounded corners.

jonathan: border + subtle shadow sounds good. also add an aspect-ratio container so thumbnails don't shift row height.

tara: copy nits: the badge that currently reads "Fail (3)" should be "Failed — 3 regressions". It's clearer to non-native speakers. Keep the short badge on very narrow screens but expand copy at >640px.

kevin: added responsive rule in the spec: badge-title expands at md breakpoint.

maya: 5) Scorecard legend ordering: we sort metrics by severity now, but the UI shows low -> high. flip to high -> low so most important metrics are first. Also include a tiny colorblind-friendly pattern indicator next to color (diagonal hatch) for high/low so color isn't the only signal.

jonathan: can we reuse existing pattern tokens from the analytics chart library? avoids creating new assets.

maya: yes, reuse tokens. Update figma tokens table.

tara: microcopy: the empty-state for regression diffs currently says "No diffs — everything looks good!" Change to "No regressions found" and add an action button "Run full test suite" to surface the re-run CTA. Also include an accessibility line: "Press R to run" in the hint area.

kevin: small UX edge: if user triggers full run with keyboard shortcut accidentally, we should show a 3s toast with undo for queued run.

maya: good. Add an affordance for undo / cancel queued run.

jonathan: implementation question — backend needs a flag for bulk-run-without-confirm to bypass modal if user invoked with modifier (e.g., Shift+R). I'll add a ticket for api-team.

maya: I'll compile a PRD with the decisions: divider + legend tooltip, info-button dialog for legend, keep primary CTA text "Approve", confirmation modal with optional note controlled by team setting, keyboard shortcuts displayed in menus and help, thumbnails border + aspect ratio, responsive badge copy, high->low legend + patterns, empty-state copy + run CTA, undo toast on keyboard-triggered runs.

tara: please add copy candidates inline in the PRD. I'll review for a11y phrasing.

design-bot: PRD draft created: https://internal.redwood.ai/prd/evs-compactness-1769991234 — reviewers: @tara @kevin @jonathan

kevin: tagging engineering estimate request — can we get an initial spike for the dialog + keyboard shortcut interactions? 2-3 pts?

jonathan: i'll sync with eng-schedule.

maya: thanks all. I'll update the figma frames and the PRD, ping back when mocks + copy are ready.

tara: :thumbsup:

kevin: :rocket:
